verdicts.reason: A: the hero can has shrunk to a tiny icon in the bottom-left corner, so the right-hand circle is an empty glow with no product in it; the headline leaves 'nights' orphaned on its own line, and the centred logo and CTA don't line up with the left-aligned text. B: the same product loss, plus the headline, subhead and CTA sit across the edge of the circle, and the sparkle panel on the left is a large empty block with nothing in it. A's split is closer to the original, so it is slightly less bad.
